WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=1 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS lhs,
               CASE WHEN id=1 THEN CAST('1' AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(p AS BIGINT) END AS rhs
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, lhs + rhs AS result FROM operands

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-2147483648' AS BIGINT)
                     WHEN 1 THEN CAST('2147483647' AS BIGINT)
                     WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS lhs,
               CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-2147483648' AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 1 THEN CAST('2147483647' AS BIGINT)
                       WHEN 3 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(p AS BIGINT) END AS rhs
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
